summary: On June 22, 2026, Enlivex Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release about its treasury portfolio of RAIN tokens, valued at approx. $1.14bn as of June 18. The filing is a routine update of an asset holding, with no mention of any M&A, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. No board recommendation or advisor is named; the registrant simply reports its token holdings and NAV per share. The filing does not constitute a special situation under event-driven categories.
